steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: She's... shattered? And the Chief did it?! Haha... I must be dreaming... This isn't real, is it?
The pure white corridor begins to twist, elongate, and sink. The dark mist in the hall seems to hear the summoning and starts to surge again. More monsters emerge from it to come at you.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ahhhh, help! I want to go back to the Bureau! Get me back to MBCC!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Bear with it, you **** damn fool! Hold your thoughts. It's just a plaster statue!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, Nightmare can't sense Enfer. Is she still alive? Is Sosia trying to kill her?
Although invisible to the naked eye, the shackles tell you Enfer is below. She is near the distorted white booth, near "Sosia"!

options: Get down. We need to save Enfer ASAP.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Ahhh!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief?!
Your steps feel sluggish, and you know this feeling. You had the same feeling when facing the frenzied "shackles" and trapped by fear.
You can still feel how the shackles shattered "Enfer." You know it's just a statue, but the scene was really powerful—It makes you afraid.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Warning. The mutation is escalating, and the contamination outside is seeping in. Can't let them come in. Labyrinth will stay behind to hold them back.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Huuuuuh? Then I'll go with the Chief! I'll protect the Chief!! I-I-I can fight so don't leave me alone!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Come on. The thing down there is an actual demon, and she can turn all the scary stuff in your head into reality! Stay here if you want to live!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Oh...I'll stay!! Go, Chief! The arrows of the Archer Queen will always be there for you!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'll go down with the Chief. How about you, Hella? Can you do it?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Of course! He's too much of a troublemaker, and I need to stick with him!
steps.female_content: Of course! She's too much of a troublemaker, and I need to stick with her!

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: I'll go, too...
She looks emotional. It seems that what happened with Enfer gave Lisa quite a shock.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: That's her greatest work and must be the most powerful.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Did she sense that Enfer was coming to destroy her, so she turned on her creator?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: But what happened to that sculpture? Is it sentient? Does it have emotions? What purpose is she acting on, and what is her power...

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: No! I have to go. I can help, and if anything happens to that person...

options: You will only bring risks with your current state.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Ouch! But...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Calm down. You're not doing this alone. Stay here and protect the team. Leave the rest to us. You can trust me.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: ...Okay. When everything here is solved, I'll join you down there. Including Enfer, if any of you don't come back, I won't forgive you!
You nod and gradually regain your composure after assigning everyone's role. The monsters behind are blocked by Lisa and the others, and you're free to move forward.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Okay, run... Ahhhh!
As you walk around the spiral staircase, more plaster monsters emerge from the trembling ground!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: For the record, I'm not afraid, and these are not from my head!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Their power comes from below. It's Sosia trying to stop us!
